plain_definition: A named supervisory instrument HKMA issues to Authorized Institutions (banks) setting out expected practices for a specific area of supervision. As part of the Cryptoassets Standard, HKMA has developed a Code of Practice covering how Authorized Institutions manage their cryptoasset exposures; it is issued and revised alongside, but is a distinct instrument from, HKMA's Supervisory Policy Manual modules on the same standard.
formal_definition: A supervisory instrument issued by HKMA to Authorized Institutions, distinct from a Supervisory Policy Manual module, setting out HKMA's expected practices for a specified area of bank supervision; HKMA has consulted on and revised a Code of Practice as part of implementing the Cryptoassets Standard.
